summary: OpenAI introduced new credit usage analytics and updated spend controls for ChatGPT Enterprise admins, including a unified Cost API and granular limit settings.

practices.reason: The new unified Cost API and admin console give engineering teams a new integration point for pulling usage data into their own systems, but it is optional tooling rather than a breaking change.
practices.quote: Access the same credit usage data through the unified Cost API for deeper analysis in their own systems
